brief.en: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
brief.zh: 伤害身边的僵尸，点击发射障碍

description.en: Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
description.zh: 冬青骑士对身边的僵尸造成伤害，还能发射三株带刺的障碍来击退并伤害僵尸。

chat.en: Holly Knight would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
chat.zh: 冬青骑士会告诫大伙不要吃他身上的莓果。“不提前打声招呼就吃别人身上的莓果是很无礼的，”他说。“另外，他们是剧毒的。”

text.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
text.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

text.en: projectiles become prickly barriers when hitting the floor
text.zh: 子弹砸中地面时生成带刺的障碍
